slides.title: Three pitfalls we see in almost every first project
bullets: **Security rules:** never ship "allow read, write: if true"
**API keys:** the web config is public - protect data with rules
**Emulator:** test locally without touching production data

slides.text: Ship a small thing early - then iterate.
slides.attribution: Our rule of thumb for hackathon projects

slides.title: Key takeaways
bullets: Firebase removes server work so you can focus on your idea
Start with Hosting, Firestore and Authentication
Write security rules **before** you share the link
Test locally with the Emulator Suite
